items.name: Viva Engage v0.1.0
items.description: Reformats a table of proposal-submission information (e.g. rows from an Excel export) into per-proposal "Proposal Submission" announcement blocks — proposal number, title, sponsor, prime sponsor, principal investigator, and budget total — suitable for pasting into Microsoft Teams / Viva Engage.

data.name: viva-engage-reformat
data.prompt:
for each row in the input, produce an output in this format:
Proposal Submission

Proposal Number:

Proposal Title:

Sponsor:

Prime Sponsor:

Principal Investigator:

Budget Total: $

validation_plan.name: One block per input row
validation_plan.description: The output contains exactly one "Proposal Submission" block per data row in the input table. FAIL if any row is dropped, merged, or if a block appears that has no corresponding input row.

validation_plan.name: All six fields present per block
validation_plan.description: Every block carries all six labeled fields in order — Proposal Number, Proposal Title, Sponsor, Prime Sponsor, Principal Investigator, Budget Total. A field whose source cell is empty still renders its label. FAIL if a label is missing or renamed.

validation_plan.name: Values verbatim from the source row
validation_plan.description: Each field value matches its source cell — proposal numbers, names, and titles copied exactly; the budget total carries a $ and preserves the source amount without rounding or reformatting beyond currency notation. FAIL on any altered or invented value.

validation_plan.name: No prose outside the blocks
validation_plan.description: The output consists only of the "Proposal Submission" blocks — no introductions, commentary, headers, or trailing remarks. FAIL if conversational text surrounds the blocks.
